int position(string[] names, string wanted)
    for: i < int(#names)
        if names[i] == wanted
            return i
    return -1

string[] read_lines(string path)
    source_text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    string[] lines := source_text.split(NL)
    if #lines > 0 and lines[-1] == ""
        lines = lines[0:<#lines - 1]
    return lines

class Attribute(int index, string name, bool is_integer, string[] values)
    int parse(string text)
        if text == "?"
            return -1
        return if is_integer then int(text) else position(values, text)

class Row(string id, int[] values, int label)
    int missing_count()
        return [for value := values[] if value < 0 then 1].sum()

int[] integer_fields(string line)
    fields := line.split(" ")
    return [for value := fields[1:<#fields][] then int(value)]

class Settings(local string[] lines)
    int max_depth := integer_fields(lines[0])[0]
    int min_split := integer_fields(lines[1])[0]
    int min_leaf := integer_fields(lines[2])[0]
    int max_surrogates := integer_fields(lines[3])[0]
    int folds := integer_fields(lines[4])[0]
    int[] curve := integer_fields(lines[5])
    int bag_trees := integer_fields(lines[6])[0]
    int bag_seed := integer_fields(lines[7])[0]
    int permutation_repeats := integer_fields(lines[8])[0]
    int permutation_seed := integer_fields(lines[9])[0]

class Dataset(Attribute[] attributes, string target, string[] classes, Row[] train, Row[] validation, Row[] test_rows, Settings settings)

Row[] read_rows(string path, Attribute[] attributes, string[] classes)
    lines := read_lines(path)
    Row[] rows := []
    for: 1 <= i < int(#lines)
        fields := lines[i].split(",")
        values := [for attribute := attributes[] then attribute.parse(fields[attribute.index + 1])]
        rows = rows.append(Row(fields[0], values, position(classes, fields[-1])))
    return rows

Dataset load()
    schema := read_lines("input/schema.txt")
    Attribute[] attributes := []
    target := ""
    string[] classes := []
    for line := schema[]
        fields := line.split(" ")
        if fields[0] == "ATTRIBUTE"
            attributes = attributes.append(Attribute(int(#attributes), fields[1], fields[2] == "INT", fields[3:<#fields]))
        else
            target = fields[1]
            classes = fields[2:<#fields]
    train := read_rows("input/train.csv", attributes, classes)
    validation := read_rows("input/validation.csv", attributes, classes)
    test_rows := read_rows("input/test.csv", attributes, classes)
    return Dataset(attributes, target, classes, train, validation, test_rows, Settings(read_lines("input/params.txt")))

import math
import dataset = "./dataset.qui"
import tree_builder = "./tree_builder.qui"

string real_text(real64 value, places := 4)
    text := if places == 6 then "{value:.6}" else "{value:.4}"
    if text == "-0.0000" or text == "-0.000000"
        return text[1:<#text]
    return text

int gcd(int first, int second)
    first = math.abs(first)
    while second != 0
        first, second = second, first % second
    return first

string ratio_text(int numerator, int denominator)
    if denominator == 0
        return "0/0 -"
    return "{numerator}/{denominator} {real_text(real64(numerator) / real64(denominator))}"

string fraction_text(int numerator, int denominator, places := 4)
    if denominator == 0
        return "- -"
    divisor := gcd(numerator, denominator)
    reduced_numerator := numerator / divisor
    reduced_denominator := denominator / divisor
    value := real64(reduced_numerator) / real64(reduced_denominator)
    return "{reduced_numerator}/{reduced_denominator} {real_text(value, places)}"

real64 average(real64[] values)
    return values.sum() / real64(#values)

class Direction(bool left, int method)
class Route(int[] path, int[] methods)

Direction direction(tree_builder.Node node, dataset.Row row)
    value := row.values[node.split.attribute.index]
    if value >= 0
        return Direction(node.split.goes_left(value), 0)
    for surrogate := node.surrogates[]
        value = row.values[surrogate.split.attribute.index]
        if value >= 0
            return Direction(surrogate.goes_left(value), 1)
    return Direction(node.default_left, 2)

class View(tree_builder.Tree tree, bool[] cut, depth_limit := -1)
    bool is_leaf(int index)
        tree_builder.Node node := tree.nodes[index]
        return node.left < 0 or cut[index] or (depth_limit >= 0 and node.depth >= depth_limit)

    int[] preorder(start := 0)
        pending := [start]
        int[] result := []
        while #pending != 0
            index := pending[-1]
            pending = pending[0:<#pending - 1]
            result = result.append(index)
            if not is_leaf(index)
                pending = pending.append(tree.nodes[index].right).append(tree.nodes[index].left)
        return result

    int[] leaves(start := 0)
        return [for index := preorder(start)[] if is_leaf(index) then index]

    int[] internal_nodes(start := 0)
        return [for index := preorder(start)[] if not is_leaf(index) then index]

    int tree_depth()
        return [for index := leaves()[] then tree.nodes[index].depth].max()

    int training_errors()
        return [for index := leaves()[] then tree.nodes[index].errors].sum()

    Route route(dataset.Row row)
        index := 0
        path := [index]
        int[] methods := []
        while not is_leaf(index)
            tree_builder.Node node := tree.nodes[index]
            choice := direction(node, row)
            index = if choice.left then node.left else node.right
            path = path.append(index)
            methods = methods.append(choice.method)
        return Route(path, methods)

    tree_builder.Node leaf_of(dataset.Row row)
        Route result := route(row)
        return tree.nodes[result.path[-1]]

    int predict(dataset.Row row)
        return leaf_of(row).prediction

    int correct_count(dataset.Row[] rows)
        return [for row := rows[] if predict(row) == row.label then 1].sum()

View full_tree(tree_builder.Tree tree)
    return View(tree, array(#tree.nodes, fill = false))

int[][] confusion_matrix(int[] actual, int[] predicted, int classes)
    int[][] matrix := array(nat(classes), fill = array(nat(classes), fill = 0))
    for: i < int(#actual)
        matrix[actual[i]][predicted[i]] += 1
    return matrix

string counts_text(int[] counts)
    return [for count := counts[] then "{count}"].join(" ")

string[] classification_lines(string title, string[] classes, int[] actual, int[] predicted)
    count := int(#classes)
    matrix := confusion_matrix(actual, predicted, count)
    correct := [for i := matrix.indices()[] then matrix[i][i]].sum()
    total := int(#actual)
    lines := ["confusion {title} correct {correct}/{total} accuracy {fraction_text(correct, total)}", "actual\predicted " + classes.join(" ")]
    for: i < count
        lines = lines.append(classes[i] + " " + counts_text(matrix[i]))
    real64[] f1 := []
    for: k < count
        hits := matrix[k][k]
        predicted_total := [for row := matrix[] then row[k]].sum()
        support := matrix[k].sum()
        if predicted_total + support > 0
            f1 = f1.append(real64(2 * hits) / real64(predicted_total + support))
        lines = lines.append("class {classes[k]} precision {fraction_text(hits, predicted_total)} recall {fraction_text(hits, support)} f1 {fraction_text(2 * hits, predicted_total + support)} support {support}")
    return lines.append("macro_f1 {real_text(average(f1))}")

import dataset = "./dataset.qui"

class Fraction(int numerator, int denominator)
    int compare(Fraction other)
        first := numerator * other.denominator
        second := other.numerator * denominator
        return if first < second then -1 elif first > second then 1 else 0

int[] class_counts(dataset.Row[] rows, int classes)
    counts := array(nat(classes), fill = 0)
    for row := rows[]
        counts[row.label] += 1
    return counts

int square_sum(int[] counts)
    return (counts ^ 2).sum()

int majority(int[] counts)
    chosen := 0
    for: 1 <= i < int(#counts)
        if counts[i] > counts[chosen]
            chosen = i
    return chosen

int error_count(int[] counts)
    return counts.sum() - counts[majority(counts)]

Fraction quality(int[] left, int[] right)
    left_size := left.sum()
    right_size := right.sum()
    return Fraction(square_sum(left) * right_size + square_sum(right) * left_size, left_size * right_size)

bool improves(Fraction value, int[] counts)
    return value.numerator * counts.sum() > square_sum(counts) * value.denominator

real64 decrease(int[] counts, int[] left, int[] right)
    first := real64(square_sum(left)) / real64(left.sum())
    second := real64(square_sum(right)) / real64(right.sum())
    parent := real64(square_sum(counts)) / real64(counts.sum())
    return (first + second) - parent

import math
import dataset = "./dataset.qui"
import impurity = "./impurity.qui"
import tree_builder = "./tree_builder.qui"
import pruning = "./pruning.qui"
import evaluation = "./evaluation.qui"

class Minstd(int state)
    int .draw()
        state = 48271 * state % 2147483647
        return state

class Condition(dataset.Attribute attribute)
    has_lower := false
    has_upper := false
    lower := 0
    upper := 0
    equal := -1
    excluded := array(#attribute.values, fill = false)

    void .add(tree_builder.Split split, bool left)
        if attribute.is_integer
            if left
                upper = if has_upper then math.min(upper, split.point) else split.point
                has_upper = true
            else
                lower = if has_lower then math.max(lower, split.point) else split.point
                has_lower = true
        elif left
            equal = split.point
        else
            excluded[split.point] = true

    string text()
        name := attribute.name
        if attribute.is_integer
            if has_lower and has_upper
                return "{tree_builder.half_text(lower)} < {name} <= {tree_builder.half_text(upper)}"
            if has_lower
                return "{name} > {tree_builder.half_text(lower)}"
            return "{name} <= {tree_builder.half_text(upper)}"
        if equal >= 0
            return "{name} = {attribute.values[equal]}"
        names := [for i := excluded.indices()[] if excluded[i] then attribute.values[i]]
        if #names == 1
            return "{name} != {names[0]}"
        return name + " not in {{" + names.join(",") + "}}"

    bool holds(dataset.Row row)
        value := row.values[attribute.index]
        if value < 0
            return false
        if attribute.is_integer
            return (not has_lower or 2 * value > lower) and (not has_upper or 2 * value <= upper)
        if equal >= 0
            return value == equal
        return not excluded[value]

class Rule(int number, int leaf, int label, Condition[] conditions)
    general := conditions
    string[] removed := []

class Coverage(int hits, int count)
class Generalization(Condition[] conditions, string[] removed)
class DepthResult(int depth, evaluation.View tree, int cv_correct)
class Bag(evaluation.View tree, int distinct_count, int out_of_bag, int correct)
class Permutation(int attribute, int[] counts, int drop)

string[] join_sections(string[][] sections)
    string[] lines := []
    for section := sections[]
        if #lines > 0
            lines = lines.append("")
        lines = lines.concat(section)
    return lines

Condition[] simplify(tree_builder.Split[] steps, bool[] directions, dataset.Attribute[] attributes)
    Condition[] conditions := []
    for attribute := attributes[]
        condition := Condition(attribute)
        present := false
        for: i < int(#steps)
            if steps[i].attribute.index == attribute.index
                .condition.add(steps[i], directions[i])
                present = true
        if present
            conditions = conditions.append(condition)
    return conditions

string conditions_text(Condition[] conditions)
    if #conditions == 0
        return "true"
    return [for condition := conditions[] then condition.text()].join(" and ")

Coverage coverage(Condition[] conditions, dataset.Row[] rows, int label)
    hits := 0
    count := 0
    for row := rows[]
        covered := true
        for condition := conditions[]
            if not condition.holds(row)
                covered = false
                break
        if covered
            count += 1
            if row.label == label
                hits += 1
    return Coverage(hits, count)

impurity.Fraction laplace(Condition[] conditions, dataset.Row[] rows, int label, int classes)
    result := coverage(conditions, rows, label)
    return impurity.Fraction(result.hits + 1, result.count + classes)

Generalization generalize(Condition[] conditions, dataset.Row[] rows, int label, int classes)
    current := conditions
    string[] removed := []
    while #current != 0
        estimate := laplace(current, rows, label, classes)
        best_index := -1
        best := impurity.Fraction(0, 1)
        for: i < int(#current)
            Condition[] trial := current[0:<i].concat(current[i + 1:<#current])
            value := laplace(trial, rows, label, classes)
            if best_index < 0 or value.compare(best) > 0
                best_index = i
                best = value
        if estimate.compare(best) > 0
            break
        removed = removed.append(current[best_index].attribute.name)
        current = current[0:<best_index].concat(current[best_index + 1:<#current])
    return Generalization(current, removed)

void collect_rules(evaluation.View tree, int index, tree_builder.Split[] steps, bool[] directions, dataset.Attribute[] attributes, Rule[] &rules)
    tree_builder.Node node := tree.tree.nodes[index]
    if tree.is_leaf(index)
        rules = rules.append(Rule(int(#rules) + 1, index, node.prediction, simplify(steps, directions, attributes)))
        return
    collect_rules(tree, node.left, steps.append(node.split), directions.append(true), attributes, &rules)
    collect_rules(tree, node.right, steps.append(node.split), directions.append(false), attributes, &rules)

Rule[] make_rules(evaluation.View tree, dataset.Attribute[] attributes, dataset.Row[] validation, int classes)
    Rule[] rules := []
    collect_rules(tree, 0, [], [], attributes, &rules)
    for: i < int(#rules)
        result := generalize(rules[i].conditions, validation, rules[i].label, classes)
        rules[i].general = result.conditions
        rules[i].removed = result.removed
    return rules

evaluation.View limited(evaluation.View tree, int depth)
    return evaluation.View(tree.tree, tree.cut, depth)

class Analysis(dataset.Dataset data)
    dataset.Attribute[] attributes := data.attributes
    string[] classes := data.classes
    dataset.Settings settings := data.settings
    dataset.Row[] train := data.train
    dataset.Row[] validation := data.validation
    dataset.Row[] test_rows := data.test_rows
    class_count := int(#classes)
    evaluation.View grown := evaluation.full_tree(tree_builder.grow(train, attributes, class_count, settings))
    local reduced := pruning.reduced_error(grown.tree, validation)
    evaluation.View pruned := reduced.tree
    pruning.Decision[] decisions := reduced.decisions
    rules := make_rules(pruned, attributes, validation, class_count)
    int[] bounds := []
    for: fold <= settings.folds
        bounds = bounds.append(fold * int(#train) / settings.folds)
    evaluation.View[] fold_trees := []
    for: 1 <= fold <= settings.folds
        dataset.Row[] training := train[0:<bounds[fold - 1]].concat(train[bounds[fold]:<#train])
        fold_trees = fold_trees.append(evaluation.full_tree(tree_builder.grow(training, attributes, class_count, settings)))
    DepthResult[] depth_results := []
    selected_depth := 0
    for: depth <= settings.max_depth
        correct := 0
        for: 1 <= fold <= settings.folds
            correct += limited(fold_trees[fold - 1], depth).correct_count(train[bounds[fold - 1]:<bounds[fold]])
        depth_results = depth_results.append(DepthResult(depth, limited(grown, depth), correct))
        if correct > depth_results[selected_depth].cv_correct
            selected_depth = depth
    pruning.SequenceTree[] sequence := pruning.cost_complexity(grown.tree)
    selected_index := 0
    for: i < int(#sequence)
        if sequence[i].tree.correct_count(validation) >= sequence[selected_index].tree.correct_count(validation)
            selected_index = i
    Bag[] bags := []
    int[][] oob_votes := array(#train, fill = array(nat(class_count), fill = 0))
    local generator := Minstd(settings.bag_seed)
    for: b < settings.bag_trees
        int[] indices := []
        sampled := array(#train, fill = false)
        for: j < int(#train)
            index := .generator.draw() % int(#train)
            indices = indices.append(index)
            sampled[index] = true
        sample := [for index := indices[] then train[index]]
        tree := evaluation.full_tree(tree_builder.grow(sample, attributes, class_count, settings))
        count := 0
        hits := 0
        distinct_count := 0
        for: i < int(#train)
            if sampled[i]
                distinct_count += 1
            else
                count += 1
                prediction := tree.predict(train[i])
                oob_votes[i][prediction] += 1
                if prediction == train[i].label
                    hits += 1
        bags = bags.append(Bag(tree, distinct_count, count, hits))
    int[][] test_votes := array(#test_rows, fill = array(nat(class_count), fill = 0))
    for bag := bags[]
        for: i < int(#test_rows)
            test_votes[i][bag.tree.predict(test_rows[i])] += 1
    evaluation.View[] models := [grown, pruned, depth_results[selected_depth].tree, sequence[selected_index].tree]
    model_labels := ["grown", "pruned", "depth", "cost_complexity", "bagging"]
    int[][] predictions := []
    for model := models[]
        predictions = predictions.append([for row := test_rows[] then model.predict(row)])
    predictions = predictions.append([for votes := test_votes[] then impurity.majority(votes)])

    string accuracy(evaluation.View tree, dataset.Row[] rows)
        return evaluation.ratio_text(tree.correct_count(rows), int(#rows))

    void node_lines(evaluation.View tree, int index, string condition, string[] &lines)
        tree_builder.Node node := tree.tree.nodes[index]
        string text := " " * nat(2 * node.depth) + "{node.number} {condition} n {node.size} counts {evaluation.counts_text(node.counts)}"
        if tree.is_leaf(index)
            lines = lines.append(text + " leaf {classes[node.prediction]}")
            return
        lines = lines.append(text)
        node_lines(tree, node.left, node.split.condition(true), &lines)
        node_lines(tree, node.right, node.split.condition(false), &lines)

    string[] tree_lines(evaluation.View tree)
        string[] lines := []
        node_lines(tree, 0, "root", &lines)
        lines = lines.append("")
        nodes := tree.preorder()
        leaves := tree.leaves()
        depth := tree.tree_depth()
        lines = lines.append("nodes {#nodes} leaves {#leaves} depth {depth} errors {evaluation.ratio_text(tree.training_errors(), int(#train))}")
        for: level <= depth
            level_nodes := [for index := nodes[] if tree.tree.nodes[index].depth == level then index]
            level_leaves := [for index := leaves[] if tree.tree.nodes[index].depth == level then index]
            int rows := [for index := level_leaves[] then tree.tree.nodes[index].size].sum()
            int errors := [for index := level_leaves[] then tree.tree.nodes[index].errors].sum()
            lines = lines.append("level {level} nodes {#level_nodes} leaves {#level_leaves} rows {rows} errors {errors}")
        return lines

    string[] root_candidate_lines()
        tree_builder.Candidate[] candidates := []
        for attribute := attributes[]
            match tree_builder.best_split(train, [attribute], class_count, settings.min_leaf)
                tree_builder.Candidate candidate
                    position := int(#candidates)
                    candidates = candidates.append(candidate)
                    while position > 0 and candidate.quality().compare(candidates[position - 1].quality()) > 0
                        candidates[position] = candidates[position - 1]
                        position -= 1
                    candidates[position] = candidate
                none
                    continue
        size := int(#train)
        int[] counts := grown.tree.nodes[0].counts
        lines := ["root candidates n {size} counts {evaluation.counts_text(counts)}"]
        for: i < int(#candidates)
            candidate := candidates[i]
            value := candidate.quality()
            gain := real64(value.numerator) / real64(value.denominator) / real64(size) - real64(impurity.square_sum(counts)) / real64(size * size)
            lines = lines.append("{i + 1} {candidate.split.condition(true)} left {candidate.left_size} right {candidate.right_size} gain {evaluation.real_text(gain, 6)}")
        return lines

    string[] surrogate_lines()
        lines := ["surrogates"]
        for index := grown.internal_nodes()[]
            tree_builder.Node node := grown.tree.nodes[index]
            string[] listed := []
            for surrogate := node.surrogates[]
                direction := if surrogate.left then "left" else "right"
                listed = listed.append("{surrogate.split.condition(true)} {direction} {surrogate.score}/{node.size}")
            text := if #listed == 0 then "none" else listed.join(" ; ")
            direction := if node.default_left then "left" else "right"
            lines = lines.append("node {node.number} split {node.split.condition(true)} default {direction} surrogates {text}")
        return lines

    string[] tree_file()
        return join_sections([root_candidate_lines(), tree_lines(grown), surrogate_lines()])

    string[] pruned_tree_file()
        lines := ["reduced_error_pruning validation {#validation}"]
        pruned_count := 0
        for decision := decisions[]
            tree_builder.Node node := grown.tree.nodes[decision.node]
            verdict := if decision.pruned then "pruned" else "kept"
            if decision.pruned
                pruned_count += 1
            lines = lines.append("node {node.number} depth {node.depth} rows {decision.rows} leaf {decision.leaf_error} subtree {decision.subtree_error} {verdict}")
        lines = lines.append("examined {#decisions} pruned {pruned_count} kept {int(#decisions) - pruned_count}")
        return lines.append("").concat(tree_lines(pruned))

    string[] predictions_file()
        lines := ["id,predicted,actual,grown,leaf,path,missing"]
        for row := test_rows[]
            route := pruned.route(row)
            tree_builder.Node leaf := pruned.tree.nodes[route.path[-1]]
            path := [for index := route.path[] then "{pruned.tree.nodes[index].number}"].join("-")
            missing := [for method := route.methods[] if method != 0 then 1].sum()
            lines = lines.append("{row.id},{classes[leaf.prediction]},{classes[row.label]},{classes[grown.predict(row)]},{leaf.number},{path},{missing}")
        return lines

    string[] rule_lines()
        lines := ["rules {#rules}"]
        for rule := rules[]
            tree_builder.Node leaf := pruned.tree.nodes[rule.leaf]
            rows := [for row := test_rows[] if pruned.leaf_of(row).number == leaf.number then row]
            hits := [for row := rows[] if row.label == rule.label then 1].sum()
            train_ratio := evaluation.ratio_text(leaf.counts.max(), leaf.size)
            lines = lines.append("rule {rule.number} node {leaf.number} if {conditions_text(rule.conditions)} then {classes[rule.label]} train {train_ratio} test {evaluation.ratio_text(hits, int(#rows))}")
        return lines

    string[] generalized_lines()
        lines := ["generalized {#rules}"]
        for rule := rules[]
            valid := coverage(rule.general, validation, rule.label)
            testing := coverage(rule.general, test_rows, rule.label)
            removed := if #rule.removed == 0 then "none" else rule.removed.join(",")
            estimate := evaluation.fraction_text(valid.hits + 1, valid.count + class_count)
            lines = lines.append("general {rule.number} if {conditions_text(rule.general)} then {classes[rule.label]} removed {removed} laplace {estimate} validation {valid.hits}/{valid.count} test {testing.hits}/{testing.count}")
        return lines

    string explanation(dataset.Row row)
        route := pruned.route(row)
        string[] parts := []
        marks := ["", " [surrogate]", " [default]"]
        for: i < int(#route.methods)
            tree_builder.Node node := pruned.tree.nodes[route.path[i]]
            left := route.path[i + 1] == node.left
            parts = parts.append(node.split.condition(left) + marks[route.methods[i]])
        return if #parts == 0 then "root" else parts.join("; ")

    string[] misclassified_lines()
        wrong := [for row := test_rows[] if pruned.predict(row) != row.label then row]
        lines := ["misclassified {#wrong}"]
        for row := wrong[]
            leaf := pruned.leaf_of(row)
            number := 0
            for rule := rules[]
                if pruned.tree.nodes[rule.leaf].number == leaf.number
                    number = rule.number
            lines = lines.append("{row.id} actual {classes[row.label]} predicted {classes[leaf.prediction]} rule {number} path {explanation(row)}")
        return lines

    string[] rules_file()
        return join_sections([rule_lines(), generalized_lines(), misclassified_lines()])

    string[] data_lines()
        lines := ["data train {#train} validation {#validation} test {#test_rows} attributes {#attributes} classes {class_count} target {data.target}"]
        train_counts := impurity.class_counts(train, class_count)
        validation_counts := impurity.class_counts(validation, class_count)
        test_counts := impurity.class_counts(test_rows, class_count)
        for: k < class_count
            lines = lines.append("class {classes[k]} train {train_counts[k]} validation {validation_counts[k]} test {test_counts[k]}")
        validation_missing := [for row := validation[] then row.missing_count()].sum()
        test_missing := [for row := test_rows[] then row.missing_count()].sum()
        lines = lines.append("missing validation {validation_missing} test {test_missing}")
        for attribute := attributes[]
            missing_validation := [for row := validation[] if row.values[attribute.index] < 0 then 1].sum()
            missing_test := [for row := test_rows[] if row.values[attribute.index] < 0 then 1].sum()
            lines = lines.append("missing {attribute.name} validation {missing_validation} test {missing_test}")
        return lines

    string summary_line(string name, evaluation.View tree)
        return "{name} nodes {#tree.preorder()} leaves {#tree.leaves()} depth {tree.tree_depth()} train {accuracy(tree, train)} validation {accuracy(tree, validation)} test {accuracy(tree, test_rows)}"

    string[] model_evaluation(int model)
        labels := [for row := test_rows[] then row.label]
        return evaluation.classification_lines(model_labels[model] + " test", classes, labels, predictions[model])

    string[] routing_lines()
        int[][] tallies := array(#pruned.tree.nodes, fill = [0, 0, 0])
        for row := test_rows[]
            route := pruned.route(row)
            for: i < int(#route.methods)
                tallies[route.path[i]][route.methods[i]] += 1
        lines := ["routing pruned test"]
        for index := pruned.internal_nodes()[]
            tally := tallies[index]
            lines = lines.append("node {pruned.tree.nodes[index].number} rows {tally.sum()} primary {tally[0]} surrogate {tally[1]} default {tally[2]}")
        complete := [for row := test_rows[] if row.missing_count() == 0 then row]
        incomplete := [for row := test_rows[] if row.missing_count() > 0 then row]
        lines = lines.append("complete rows {#complete} correct {accuracy(pruned, complete)}")
        return lines.append("incomplete rows {#incomplete} correct {accuracy(pruned, incomplete)}")

    string[] cross_validation_lines()
        lines := ["cross_validation folds {settings.folds}"]
        total := 0
        for: 1 <= fold <= settings.folds
            tree := fold_trees[fold - 1]
            rows := train[bounds[fold - 1]:<bounds[fold]]
            correct := tree.correct_count(rows)
            total += correct
            lines = lines.append("fold {fold} rows {bounds[fold - 1] + 1}-{bounds[fold]} leaves {#tree.leaves()} correct {evaluation.ratio_text(correct, int(#rows))}")
        return lines.append("cv accuracy {evaluation.ratio_text(total, int(#train))}")

    string[] depth_lines()
        lines := ["depth_selection"]
        for result := depth_results[]
            tree := result.tree
            lines = lines.append("depth {result.depth} leaves {#tree.leaves()} cv {evaluation.ratio_text(result.cv_correct, int(#train))} train {accuracy(tree, train)} validation {accuracy(tree, validation)} test {accuracy(tree, test_rows)}")
        chosen := depth_results[selected_depth]
        return lines.append("selected depth {chosen.depth} leaves {#chosen.tree.leaves()} test {accuracy(chosen.tree, test_rows)}")

    string[] cost_complexity_lines()
        lines := ["cost_complexity"]
        for: i < int(#sequence)
            step := sequence[i]
            alpha := evaluation.fraction_text(step.alpha.numerator, step.alpha.denominator * int(#train), 6)
            errors := int(#validation) - step.tree.correct_count(validation)
            lines = lines.append("subtree {i} alpha {alpha} leaves {#step.tree.leaves()} train_errors {step.tree.training_errors()} validation_errors {errors}")
        chosen := sequence[selected_index].tree
        return lines.append("selected subtree {selected_index} leaves {#chosen.leaves()} test {accuracy(chosen, test_rows)}")

    string[] bagging_lines()
        lines := ["bagging trees {settings.bag_trees} seed {settings.bag_seed}"]
        for: i < int(#bags)
            bag := bags[i]
            lines = lines.append("bag {i + 1} distinct {bag.distinct_count} leaves {#bag.tree.leaves()} oob {evaluation.ratio_text(bag.correct, bag.out_of_bag)}")
        voted := 0
        hits := 0
        for: i < int(#train)
            if oob_votes[i].sum() > 0
                voted += 1
                if impurity.majority(oob_votes[i]) == train[i].label
                    hits += 1
        lines = lines.append("oob accuracy {evaluation.ratio_text(hits, voted)} unvoted {int(#train) - voted}")
        return lines.concat(model_evaluation(4))

    string[] mcnemar_lines()
        lines := ["mcnemar pruned test"]
        for model := [0, 2, 3, 4][]
            b := 0
            c := 0
            for: i < int(#test_rows)
                first := predictions[1][i] == test_rows[i].label
                second := predictions[model][i] == test_rows[i].label
                if first and not second
                    b += 1
                elif second and not first
                    c += 1
            disagreements := b + c
            corrected := math.max(0, math.abs(b - c) - 1)
            squared := corrected * corrected
            statistic := if disagreements == 0 then "0/1 0.0000" else evaluation.fraction_text(squared, disagreements)
            significant := if 1000 * squared > 3841 * disagreements then "yes" else "no"
            lines = lines.append("versus {model_labels[model]} b {b} c {c} statistic {statistic} significant {significant}")
        return lines

    impurity.Fraction[][] scores(int model)
        impurity.Fraction[][] result := []
        if model == 4
            for votes := test_votes[]
                result = result.append([for count := votes[] then impurity.Fraction(count, settings.bag_trees)])
            return result
        tree := if model == 0 then grown else pruned
        for row := test_rows[]
            leaf := tree.leaf_of(row)
            result = result.append([for count := leaf.counts[] then impurity.Fraction(count, leaf.size)])
        return result

    string[] auc_lines()
        string[] lines := []
        for model := [0, 1, 4][]
            impurity.Fraction[][] values := scores(model)
            string[] parts := ["auc", model_labels[model]]
            real64[] averages := []
            for: label < class_count
                positives := 0
                wins := 0
                for: i < int(#test_rows)
                    if test_rows[i].label != label
                        continue
                    positives += 1
                    for: j < int(#test_rows)
                        if test_rows[j].label == label
                            continue
                        comparison := values[i][label].compare(values[j][label])
                        if comparison > 0
                            wins += 2
                        elif comparison == 0
                            wins += 1
                pairs := 2 * positives * (int(#test_rows) - positives)
                parts = parts.append(classes[label]).append(evaluation.fraction_text(wins, pairs))
                if pairs > 0
                    averages = averages.append(real64(wins) / real64(pairs))
            macro := if #averages == 0 then "-" else evaluation.real_text(evaluation.average(averages))
            lines = lines.append(parts.append("macro").append(macro).join(" "))
        return lines

    string[] learning_curve_lines()
        lines := ["learning_curve"]
        for size := settings.curve[]
            initial := evaluation.full_tree(tree_builder.grow(train[0:<size], attributes, class_count, settings))
            result := pruning.reduced_error(initial.tree, validation)
            lines = lines.append("size {size} grown leaves {#initial.leaves()} test {accuracy(initial, test_rows)} pruned leaves {#result.tree.leaves()} test {accuracy(result.tree, test_rows)}")
        return lines

    string[] evaluation_file()
        return join_sections([data_lines(), [summary_line("grown", grown), summary_line("pruned", pruned)], model_evaluation(0), model_evaluation(1), routing_lines(), cross_validation_lines(), depth_lines(), cost_complexity_lines(), bagging_lines(), mcnemar_lines(), auc_lines(), learning_curve_lines()])

    string[] impurity_lines(string title, evaluation.View tree)
        real64[] importance := array(#attributes, fill = 0.0)
        splits := array(#attributes, fill = 0)
        for index := tree.internal_nodes()[]
            tree_builder.Node node := tree.tree.nodes[index]
            int a := node.split.attribute.index
            importance[a] += impurity.decrease(node.counts, tree.tree.nodes[node.left].counts, tree.tree.nodes[node.right].counts)
            splits[a] += 1
        total := importance.sum()
        shares := [for value := importance[] then if total == 0.0 then 0.0 else value / total]
        int[] rounded_shares := []
        for value := shares[]
            rounded := math.round(value * 10000.0)
            rounded_shares = rounded_shares.append(rounded)
        int[] order := []
        for: a < int(#attributes)
            position := int(#order)
            order = order.append(a)
            while position > 0 and rounded_shares[order[position - 1]] < rounded_shares[a]
                order[position] = order[position - 1]
                position -= 1
            order[position] = a
        lines := ["impurity {title}"]
        for: i < int(#order)
            a := order[i]
            decrease := importance[a] / real64(#train)
            lines = lines.append("{i + 1} {attributes[a].name} decrease {evaluation.real_text(decrease)} share {evaluation.real_text(shares[a])} splits {splits[a]}")
        return lines

    string[] permutation_lines()
        permutation_generator := Minstd(settings.permutation_seed)
        repeats := settings.permutation_repeats
        size := int(#test_rows)
        base := pruned.correct_count(test_rows)
        Permutation[] results := []
        for attribute := attributes[]
            int[] counts := []
            for: repetition < repeats
                values := [for row := test_rows[] then row.values[attribute.index]]
                for: size >= position >= 2
                    other := .permutation_generator.draw() % position
                    saved := values[position - 1]
                    values[position - 1] = values[other]
                    values[other] = saved
                rows := test_rows
                for: i < size
                    rows[i].values[attribute.index] = values[i]
                counts = counts.append(pruned.correct_count(rows))
            result := Permutation(attribute.index, counts, repeats * base - counts.sum())
            position := int(#results)
            results = results.append(result)
            while position > 0 and results[position - 1].drop < result.drop
                results[position] = results[position - 1]
                position -= 1
            results[position] = result
        lines := ["permutation pruned test repeats {repeats} seed {settings.permutation_seed} base {evaluation.ratio_text(base, size)}"]
        for: i < int(#results)
            result := results[i]
            lines = lines.append("{i + 1} {attributes[result.attribute].name} correct {evaluation.counts_text(result.counts)} drop {evaluation.fraction_text(result.drop, repeats * size)}")
        return lines

    string[] importance_file()
        return join_sections([impurity_lines("grown", grown), impurity_lines("pruned", pruned), permutation_lines()])

    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)

import dataset = "./dataset.qui"
import impurity = "./impurity.qui"
import tree_builder = "./tree_builder.qui"
import evaluation = "./evaluation.qui"

class Decision(int node, int rows, int leaf_error, int subtree_error, bool pruned)
class Reduced(evaluation.View tree, Decision[] decisions)
class SequenceTree(impurity.Fraction alpha, evaluation.View tree)

dataset.Row[][] reached_rows(evaluation.View tree, dataset.Row[] rows)
    dataset.Row[][] result := array(#tree.tree.nodes, fill = [])
    for row := rows[]
        for index := tree.route(row).path[]
            result[index] = result[index].append(row)
    return result

int decide(tree_builder.Tree tree, int index, dataset.Row[][] reached, Decision[] &decisions, bool[] &cut)
    tree_builder.Node node := tree.nodes[index]
    leaf_error := [for row := reached[index][] if row.label != node.prediction then 1].sum()
    if node.left < 0
        return leaf_error
    subtree_error := decide(tree, node.left, reached, &decisions, &cut)
    subtree_error += decide(tree, node.right, reached, &decisions, &cut)
    pruned := leaf_error <= subtree_error
    decisions = decisions.append(Decision(index, int(#reached[index]), leaf_error, subtree_error, pruned))
    if pruned
        cut[index] = true
        return leaf_error
    return subtree_error

Reduced reduced_error(tree_builder.Tree tree, dataset.Row[] rows)
    grown := evaluation.full_tree(tree)
    reached := reached_rows(grown, rows)
    Decision[] decisions := []
    cut := grown.cut
    decide(tree, 0, reached, &decisions, &cut)
    return Reduced(evaluation.View(tree, cut), decisions)

SequenceTree[] cost_complexity(tree_builder.Tree tree)
    current := evaluation.full_tree(tree)
    result := [SequenceTree(impurity.Fraction(0, 1), current)]
    while not current.is_leaf(0)
        alpha := impurity.Fraction(0, 1)
        selected := false
        weakest := array(#tree.nodes, fill = false)
        for index := current.internal_nodes()[]
            leaves := current.leaves(index)
            int errors := [for leaf := leaves[] then tree.nodes[leaf].errors].sum()
            strength := impurity.Fraction(tree.nodes[index].errors - errors, int(#leaves) - 1)
            if not selected or strength.compare(alpha) < 0
                alpha = strength
                selected = true
                weakest = array(#tree.nodes, fill = false)
                weakest[index] = true
            elif strength.compare(alpha) == 0
                weakest[index] = true
        cut := current.cut
        for: index < int(#cut)
            if weakest[index]
                cut[index] = true
        current = evaluation.View(tree, cut)
        result = result.append(SequenceTree(alpha, current))
    return result

import math
import dataset = "./dataset.qui"
import impurity = "./impurity.qui"

string half_text(int value)
    return "{value / 2}.{5 * (value % 2)}"

class Split(dataset.Attribute attribute, int point)
    bool goes_left(int value)
        return if attribute.is_integer then 2 * value <= point else value == point

    string condition(bool left)
        if attribute.is_integer
            relation := if left then " <= " else " > "
            return attribute.name + relation + half_text(point)
        relation := if left then " = " else " != "
        return attribute.name + relation + attribute.values[point]

class Surrogate(Split split, bool left, int score)
    bool goes_left(int value)
        return split.goes_left(value) == left

class Candidate(Split split, int[] left_counts, int[] right_counts)
    int left_size := left_counts.sum()
    int right_size := right_counts.sum()

    impurity.Fraction quality()
        return impurity.quality(left_counts, right_counts)

class Node(int number, int depth, int[] counts)
    int size := counts.sum()
    int prediction := impurity.majority(counts)
    int errors := impurity.error_count(counts)
    split := Split(dataset.Attribute(-1, "", true, []), 0)
    Surrogate[] surrogates := []
    default_left := true
    left := -1
    right := -1

class Tree(Node[] nodes)

int[] counts_at(map<int, int[]> groups, int value, int classes)
    match groups.get(value)
        int[] counts
            return counts
        none
            return array(nat(classes), fill = 0)

Candidate[] candidates(dataset.Attribute attribute, dataset.Row[] rows, int[] labels, int classes)
    map<int, int[]> groups
    total := array(nat(classes), fill = 0)
    for: i < int(#rows)
        value := rows[i].values[attribute.index]
        counts := counts_at(groups, value, classes)
        counts[labels[i]] += 1
        .groups.set(value, counts)
        total[labels[i]] += 1
    ordered := groups.keys().sorted()
    Candidate[] result := []
    if attribute.is_integer
        left := array(nat(classes), fill = 0)
        for: i < int(#ordered) - 1
            left = left + counts_at(groups, ordered[i], classes)
            result = result.append(Candidate(Split(attribute, ordered[i] + ordered[i + 1]), left, total - left))
    elif #ordered > 1
        for value := ordered[]
            left := counts_at(groups, value, classes)
            result = result.append(Candidate(Split(attribute, value), left, total - left))
    return result

Candidate | none best_split(dataset.Row[] rows, dataset.Attribute[] attributes, int classes, int min_leaf)
    labels := [for row := rows[] then row.label]
    Candidate | none best := none
    for attribute := attributes[]
        for candidate := candidates(attribute, rows, labels, classes)[]
            if candidate.left_size < min_leaf or candidate.right_size < min_leaf
                continue
            replace := false
            match best
                Candidate previous
                    replace = candidate.quality().compare(previous.quality()) > 0
                none
                    replace = true
            if replace
                best = candidate
    return best

Surrogate[] find_surrogates(dataset.Row[] rows, Split primary, dataset.Attribute[] attributes, int limit)
    directions := [for row := rows[] then if primary.goes_left(row.values[primary.attribute.index]) then 0 else 1]
    count := int(#rows)
    left_size := count - directions.sum()
    baseline := math.max(left_size, count - left_size)
    Surrogate[] result := []
    for attribute := attributes[]
        if attribute.index == primary.attribute.index
            continue
        Surrogate | none best := none
        for candidate := candidates(attribute, rows, directions, 2)[]
            agreement := candidate.left_counts[0] + candidate.right_counts[1]
            value := Surrogate(candidate.split, agreement >= count - agreement, math.max(agreement, count - agreement))
            replace := false
            match best
                Surrogate previous
                    replace = value.score > previous.score
                none
                    replace = true
            if replace
                best = value
        match best
            Surrogate value
                if value.score > baseline
                    position := int(#result)
                    result = result.append(value)
                    while position > 0 and result[position - 1].score < value.score
                        result[position] = result[position - 1]
                        position -= 1
                    result[position] = value
            none
                continue
    return result[0:<math.min(limit, int(#result))]

class Builder(dataset.Attribute[] attributes, int classes, dataset.Settings settings)
    Node[] nodes := []

    int .grow_node(dataset.Row[] rows, int number, int depth)
        node := Node(number, depth, impurity.class_counts(rows, classes))
        index := int(#nodes)
        nodes = nodes.append(node)
        if node.errors == 0 or depth == settings.max_depth or node.size < settings.min_split
            return index
        match best_split(rows, attributes, classes, settings.min_leaf)
            Candidate candidate
                if not impurity.improves(candidate.quality(), node.counts)
                    return index
                split := candidate.split
                left_rows := [for row := rows[] if split.goes_left(row.values[split.attribute.index]) then row]
                right_rows := [for row := rows[] if not split.goes_left(row.values[split.attribute.index]) then row]
                node.split = split
                node.surrogates = find_surrogates(rows, split, attributes, settings.max_surrogates)
                node.default_left = #left_rows >= #right_rows
                node.left = .grow_node(left_rows, 2 * number, depth + 1)
                node.right = .grow_node(right_rows, 2 * number + 1, depth + 1)
                nodes[index] = node
            none
                return index
        return index

Tree grow(dataset.Row[] rows, dataset.Attribute[] attributes, int classes, dataset.Settings settings)
    builder := Builder(attributes, classes, settings)
    .builder.grow_node(rows, 1, 0)
    return Tree(builder.nodes)
